f.title: Submit all AEs, AEFIs and SAEs to MCAZ via the e-PV portal after approval
f.statement: After approval of the clinical trial application, the principal investigator is required to submit to MCAZ all adverse events, adverse events following immunisation and serious adverse events through the electronic pharmacovigilance (e-PV) portal.
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: After approval of the clinical trial application, the principal investigator is required to submit to MCAZ all Adverse Events (AEs), Adverse Events Following Immunization (AEFIs) and Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) safety reporting via the Electronic Pharmacovigilance (E-PV) system portal
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Include safety parameters, AE procedures and DSMB details in the protocol
f.statement: The protocol safety section will include safety parameters; methods and timing for assessing, recording and analysing them; procedures for eliciting, recording and reporting adverse events and co-occurring illnesses; type and duration of follow-up after adverse events; body fluid collection; and the names, composition and qualifications of the DSMB or SMC, with the chairperson's name stated.
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: The names, composition, and qualifications of the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Safety Monitoring Committee (SMC), name of the Chairperson must be stated.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Include prior human safety information in the Investigator's Brochure
f.statement: The investigator's brochure must contain, among other information, safety, pharmacodynamics, efficacy and dose-response information obtained from previous clinical trials in humans, and toxicological effects in animals.
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: Information regarding safety, pharmacodynamics, efficacy and dose responses that were obtained from previous clinical trials in humans.

f.title: Set up a DSMB/DMC/SMC with qualified independent members and submit its charter
f.statement: Clinical trials are required to set up a DSMB/DMC/SMC. The sponsor shall appoint members with relevant expertise (e.g. statisticians, clinicians), trial and DSMB experience and no serious conflicts of interest; the principal investigator shall submit a DSMB/DMC charter with aims and objectives, composition, chairperson and members, and meeting organisation.
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: The sponsor shall appoint members of a DSMB/DMC/SMC by considering selection of individuals with relevant expertise
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Implement urgent safety amendments immediately and notify within 48 hours
f.statement: If an amendment is considered urgent and crucial to protect the life or well-being of participants or the community, it may be implemented immediately; the investigator must inform the IRB/IEC/MRCZ and MCAZ as soon as possible by telephone, followed by a written full explanation and the amendment application within 48 hours.
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.deadline: Telephone as soon as possible; written explanation and amendment application within 48 hours

rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

deadline_rule.clock_start: the change may be effected immediately

f.title: Obtain MCAZ written approval before implementing safety-affecting amendments
f.statement: If an amendment affects participant safety (e.g. dose, regimen, concomitant medication, monitoring), it must be submitted in full and written MCAZ approval obtained before implementation.
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: If the amendment affects the safety of the trial participants (e.g. changes to dose, regimen, concomitant medication, monitoring, etc.) the amendment must be submitted in full and approval in writing from the MCAZ must be obtained prior to implementation.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Report individual case safety reports to MCAZ
f.statement: It is a mandatory requirement for the applicant to report individual case safety reports (AEs, ADRs and/or AEFIs) to MCAZ; the principal investigator is responsible for reporting safety reports to the Authority.
f.clause: 5.6.2.1 Reporting of clinical trial safety reports
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

f.title: Report SAEs to MCAZ within 7 calendar days of the investigator knowing
f.statement: Serious adverse events during the trial must be reported to MCAZ as soon as possible and no later than 7 calendar days of the occurrence being known by the principal investigator/investigators.
f.clause: 5.6.2.1 Reporting of clinical trial safety reports
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

f.title: Follow SAE reports with a complete report within 8 additional days on e-PV
f.statement: The initial SAE report must be followed by as complete a report as possible within 8 additional calendar days, including an assessment of the importance and implications of the findings and relevant previous experience with the same or similar products, submitted online on the MCAZ e-PV system.
f.clause: 5.6.2.1 Reporting of clinical trial safety reports
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

f.title: Submit non-serious AEs as line listings with annual reports
f.statement: Non-serious adverse events should not be submitted routinely but as line listings and summaries with the annual reports; the Authority may request further information.

f.title: Report foreign ICSRs within 7 days only for major safety issues or regulatory decisions
f.statement: Foreign ICSRs should not be submitted routinely but should be reported within 7 days when there is a major safety issue or regulatory decision that changes the product's risk-benefit profile, or on specific request by the Authority.
f.clause: 5.6.2.2 Reporting of clinical trial safety reports

f.title: Report product defects of investigational and study medicines
f.statement: Product defects of investigational products and other study medicines are required to be reported using the MCAZ product defect form and the MCAZ guideline on notification of medicinal product problems or defects and recall.

f.title: Submit DSMB reports and related safety amendments via e-CTR
f.statement: DSMB/DMC and other safety reports on benefit-risk assessment, and resulting protocol amendments or clarification memoranda, should be submitted to MCAZ on the e-CTR platform; protocol deviation and violation reports with corrective action should also be submitted.
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

f.title: Submit annual progress reports by 31 January
f.statement: Principal investigators are required to submit annual progress reports for all running clinical trials on the Clinical Trial Annual Progress Reporting Form by 31 January each year, with relevant attachments (including non-serious AE line listings and summaries).
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

f.title: Submit a final report also for studies stopped early for safety reasons
f.statement: The applicant must submit a preliminary report 3 months and a final report 6 months after study completion; a final report is also required for a study prematurely stopped for safety or other reasons. Publishing results without prior submission to MCAZ is an offence under MASCA sections 22 and 24.
f.legal_basis: Medicines and Allied Substances Control Act [Chapter 15:03], ss. 22 and 24
f.applicability: Clinical trials authorised by MCAZ in Zimbabwe (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

f.statement: Any update to the Investigator's Brochure, package inserts, safety reports from all active sites, notifications of safety signals, emergency preparedness and response plans, and information given to participants should be submitted as soon as it becomes available to the study team.

f.statement: The application must state the procedure for keeping participant lists and participant records for each participant and the method of recording adverse reactions; records should permit easy identification of individual participants.
